items.description: The line detail shows a non-causal definition instead of the causal explain text, for all 24 lines.
steps: Add a render_smoke assertion that lineModal output for flights and credit_spread contains none of the old causal explain wording (sample two EN sentences and one ZH sentence from the current explain fields); run node tests/render_smoke.js and record the failure.

Replace LINES[].explain with LINES[].measures for all 24 entries in docs/index.html, using the EN and ZH definitions from the design deck's measures table (quantity, population, sampling, unit, no causal connectives).
Update lineModal and every other reader of .explain so the detail renders measures, source, and the recorded comparison direction, and nothing else explanatory.

Add a lint assertion in tests/lint_public_surface.py that no measures string in docs/index.html contains a causal connective from a fixed word list (because, causes, caused by, means that, 说明, 意味着, 导致, 正是因为).
Run every verification gate and record the output.
items.regression_notes: Iteration 1. lines replaced with measures in all 24 LINES entries (copy verbatim from the design deck section 4); lineModal and openTier2Modal render measures under a new measuresLabel key (Measures / 测量内容) beside the existing direction and source tags; no explain field or reader remains. render_smoke asserts the retired causal sentences (two EN, one ZH) never render and each line's own measures string does. lint_public_surface binds every const LINES entry to non-empty EN and ZH measures, asserts explain is gone, and rejects the eight causal connectives. Gates: gate 415 passed; lint 69 OK; forbidden literal 3 OK; audit 28 OK; replay exit 0 (rows=2878, divergence=0); pending 6 tagged / 0 overdue; render smoke OK; annotations cmp identical.

items.description: The headline states a fraction of comparable lines with an unusual reading, and the resonance wording is gone.
steps: Add a render_smoke assertion that the headline label matches the design's count label pattern with a numerator and a denominator in both languages and does not contain Resonance, 共振, or the only number that matters; record the failure.

Replace the headline strings in both locales with the design's countTitle, countLabel, countQuestion, countModalTitle and countModalBody, keeping the existing comparable-line denominator rule in render().
Delete resoTitle and resoBody and the code that renders them, and move the count explanation modal to the new countModal strings.
Update every existing test that binds one of the replaced strings to the new string in the same commit, without weakening the assertion.
Run every verification gate and record the output.
items.regression_notes: Iteration 2. Headline is the deck's one canonical fraction in both locales: countLabel '{n} / {m} readings unusual today' / '今天有 {n}/{m} 条读数偏离各自近期记录', split in render() around its two numbers so #count-n and #count-of stay separate display elements while the rendered sentence stays exact; the denominator keeps the existing roster-minus-dark/blind/closed rule, and the same value is stored in headlineDenominator and inserted into countModalBody's {m}. countTitle now heads the block (it replaced changeKicker here, earlier than item 3 lists, because that is the block-heading slot); countQuestion replaced countQ; resoTitle/resoBody and resoModal are gone, replaced by countModalTitle/countModalBody behind the same #count click. calm/tremblingOne/tremblingMany are deleted: the deck has no zero phrase, so the zero case uses countLabel too (this pre-empts that part of item 3). render_smoke T27 assembles the rendered headline from its own fragments and matches the deck pattern with matching numerator/denominator in both languages for a 2/4 and a 0/1 case, asserts the title, question, modal title and a countModalBody marker, and bans Resonance/共振/only number that matters/唯一重要的数字 from the block and its modal; render_smoke's resoModal references were renamed to countModal. Gates: gate 415 passed; lint 69 OK; forbidden literal 3 OK; audit 28 OK; replay exit 0 (1439 rows since STABLE_SINCE, divergence 0); pending 6 tagged / 0 overdue; render smoke OK; annotations cmp identical.

items.description: Zero readings and every row status are described without a calm or alarm word, and each of the six statuses has page copy.
steps: Add a render_smoke assertion that the zero-reading copy in both languages does not contain calm or 平静, and that statusLabel carries an entry for scoring; record the failure.
Replace the zero-state strings with the design's wording that a reading being absent or inside its recent range says nothing about the world.
Add the missing scoring entry to statusLabel and migrate the status words for warming-up, no-spread, stale, dark and closed to the design deck.
Migrate the headline qualifiers darkNote, closedNote, blindNote, calibNote, whichNote and runNote to the design deck in both locales.
Run every verification gate and record the output.
items.regression_notes:
Iteration 3. statusLabel now carries the deck's copy for all six statuses: scoring 'Compared with recent record' / '已与近期记录比较' added; warming-up, no-spread, stale, dark, closed migrated. Count qualifiers migrated: darkNote, closedNote, blindNote, calibNote, whichNote renamed whichLines, runNote. The zero case uses countLabel alone and blindNote no longer contrasts a reading with calm. New countQualifying ('A statistical comparison, not a judgment of conditions.' / '这是统计比较，不替处境下判断。') renders in a #count-qualifying

under the count block, with one new muted CSS rule. render_smoke T28 binds the six labels and seven qualifier sentences in both languages, asserts no calm/平静 word in the rendered zero-count block, and asserts the qualifying copy; T21's gap-chip text was rebound from NO DATA/无数据 to the new dark label. lint_public_surface's statusLabel key assertion now requires exactly the six normalize statuses (was the five non-scoring ones), so a missing scoring label is red. Gates: gate 415 passed; lint 69 OK; forbidden literal 3 OK; audit 28 OK; replay exit 0 (1439 rows since STABLE_SINCE, divergence 0); pending 6 tagged / 0 overdue; render smoke OK; annotations cmp identical.

items.description: The numbered two-probe framing is deleted and the structural copy describes a record rather than probes.
steps: Add a render_smoke or lint assertion that the page text contains no circled-probe kicker and no change probe wording; record the failure.
Delete the changeKicker key and its DOM assignment in docs/index.html.

Migrate title, promise, asOf, countQ, nodata, more, dirUp, dirDown, last, noCollect, source, every range_ string, covTitle, covLead, covLead2, covTail, covMore, covBlind and notCounted to the design deck in both locales.
Keep notCounted visible in the watchlist wording so a reader can tell which collected lines never enter the count.
Run every verification gate and record the output.
items.regression_notes: Iteration 4. The numbered two-probe framing is gone: changeKicker was already deleted by item 2, levelKicker (② …) is deleted in both locales, and the #level-kicker element now renders referenceTitle, so no circled kicker (①/②/③) and no probe/探针 wording appears anywhere in docs/index.html. Structural copy is the deck's: title + promise (tag removed; document.title set per language), asOf, nodata (NO READING / 无读数), more, dirUp/dirDown (rising/falling), range_30/90/365/all, the last-value label (latest), notCounted, watchTitle, watchDays and coverage (function over the watches-derived region list) + covMore. covTitle/covLead/covLead2/covTail/covBlind are replaced by limitsTitle/limitsBody/limitsFlights in the coverage panel; levelTitle/levelBody/levelAsof are replaced by referenceTitle/referenceBody/referenceAsOf, and levelHead now counts readings below a fixed reference. countQ and source already held deck strings. tests/render_smoke.js T29 binds every migrated string in both languages, bans ①/②/③ and probe/探针 across the rendered page and every detail panel, asserts the deck's gap word and detail link render, the coverage panel carries the limits block, the reference panel carries its rule, a watchlist detail carries the not-counted line, and the retired keys tag/changeKicker/levelKicker/asof are gone. tests/audit_record.py's flights-reach phrase list was rebound to the new limitsFlights copy with each share and z figure bound separately in both languages, which is stricter than the old combined phrases. Gates: gate 415 passed; lint 69 OK; forbidden literal 3 OK; audit 28 OK; replay exit 0 (1439 rows since STABLE_SINCE, divergence 0); pending 6 tagged / 0 overdue; render smoke OK; annotations cmp identical.

items.description: The page states its four limitations in visible body text, plus the measured flights sampling-weight fact.
steps: Add a render_smoke assertion that the rendered page text contains a marker phrase for each of the four limitations in both languages; record the failure.
Add an inline scope and limits section below the collected records in docs/index.html, with the EN and ZH wording from the design deck.

Include all four limitations as visible text: a rolling comparison cannot see a long-running state; the panel is selected under written assumptions; some lines are collected and never counted; no line watches communications so a worldwide connectivity failure reads zero.
Include the measured flights sampling-weight fact from the design deck as one sentence in the same section.
Run every verification gate and record the output.

items.description: The headline, markers and status labels use one neutral treatment instead of a green to red severity ramp.
steps: Add a lint assertion that docs/index.html defines no countColor function and that the headline element does not reference a hue variable; record the failure.
Remove countColor and every call to it; render the count and the reference count in one neutral ink tone with emphasis carried by size and weight.

Replace the four-way status and marker colouring with one neutral treatment for the count marker, the line cards, the system status line and the unusual marker, keeping series hues only for chart traces.
Remove the adjudicated hatch rule and its class from the trembling pill.
Update every existing test that asserts on the removed classes or colours to assert the neutral treatment instead.
Run every verification gate and record the output.

items.description: The per-line direction is labelled as a recorded hypothesis under a neutral field name.
steps: Add a lint assertion in tests/lint_registry.py that docs/index.html declares declared_dir for every line instead of alarm; record the failure.

Rename the alarm field to declared_dir in all 24 LINES entries in docs/index.html and update the legend and tooltip wording to describe it as the comparison direction recorded when the line was built, not a verdict.
Change the chart title in render.py from alarming when to the recorded comparison direction wording.
Update the docs-side parser regex and test name in tests/lint_registry.py in the same commit so the agreement test still compares the field to each fetcher's ANOMALY_DIRECTION.
Run every verification gate and record the output.

items.description: README and the public copy pass the vocabulary guard, and the guard exists as a test.
steps: Rewrite the README opening so it describes a daily record of readings compared with their own recent history, without the world-disorder question and without alarm or resonance.

Add lint assertions that scan user-visible strings only (the T locale objects, LINES label, source, measures, watches, domain, and README prose) for alarm, 报警, resonance, 共振, calm or 平静 as a zero-state word, and the layer vocabulary (第一层, 第二层, 第三层, Layer 1/2/3, L1/L2/L3, tier of analysis); record the failure, then fix the residual strings.
Confirm the guard does not scan CSS class names or internal identifiers, and add a test comment stating that scope.
Run every verification gate; every gate must pass with the guard in place.
